Search for papers related to reinforcement learning under the topics of computer science and mathematics on arxiv, with recent submission dates between September 2024 and January 2025.

Rules:
- Work entirely in this one browser tab. Do NOT open new tabs.
- Do NOT use a search engine (Google, Bing, etc.) or cached/archived copies (e.g. web.archive.org). Navigate the site itself, starting from https://arxiv.org/.
- When the task is complete, give your final answer as plain text in your last message.
